notAnApproval: This record approves nothing and changes no artifact. It reports what printedname is and why the requested family-owned correction does not exist.

objectionsReproduced.reviewerCondition: protection established by geometry where required, not label alone
objectionsReproduced.evidence: production-field-map.json binds { field: printedname, class: participant, factId: participant.full_legal_name, factBasis: "field_name" }. factBasis is field_name, so the binding was decided by the field's own name. The geometry channel did not participate, for the reason below.

objectionsReproduced.reviewerCondition: no clipping, no silent truncation, no duplicated preprinted caption
objectionsReproduced.evidence: printedname is a single AcroForm field carrying TWO widgets. One value therefore renders in two different blocks on two different pages.

whatPrintednameActuallyIs.answer: a service declarant, and simultaneously a page-1 notice signer — because it is one field, not two

widgets.context: the notice signer block at the foot of the Notice of Hearing
the Certificate of Service block — 'I ____, verify that on ____ (date) I served a true and accurate copy of this notice upon the appropriate parties to this proceeding', with 'Printed Name:' beneath

whatPrintednameActuallyIs.theDecisiveFact: A PDF field with two widgets renders the same value at both. There is no value that is correct in both places: page 2 asks who performed service, and the platform does not know that and must never assert it. So printedname cannot be a participant caption, and no binding of it can be safe.
whatPrintednameActuallyIs.correctDisposition: refuse — protected as a service declarant

classification.correct: a protected actor class (service declarant), which NEVER_WRITE already refuses

whyTheSharedCorrectionDidNotCloseIt.finding: The geometry/label channel is live for this family, and its region input is unusable — the anchor capture stored raw CID codes instead of decoded text.
whyTheSharedCorrectionDidNotCloseIt.howDecoded: the stored value is UTF-16BE whose low bytes are the font's CID codes; adding this font's +29 offset yields readable text
whyTheSharedCorrectionDidNotCloseIt.consequence: Two failures at once. The region heading is mojibake, so no protect rule can match it. And the text it decodes to is a fragment of the page-1 notice sentence, so even decoded it describes the WRONG widget — the field's page-2 Certificate of Service context is never seen at all.
whyTheSharedCorrectionDidNotCloseIt.whyThatIsNotFamilyOwned: rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs produced this value. Every form using the same font encoding is affected; the three Nebraska families share this caption block. A per-family patch would leave the same defect live everywhere else.

whyNoSmallestFamilyOwnedCorrectionExists.classificationRoute: field-classification.json is generated by classify(name, type, ownership) inside the driver. No family-owned classification override is read from anywhere. Hand-editing the file would be overwritten by the very rerender the correction is supposed to be proven against.
whyNoSmallestFamilyOwnedCorrectionExists.fieldMapRoute: production-field-map.json is generated by the same run, for the same reason.
whyNoSmallestFamilyOwnedCorrectionExists.explicitFieldMappingsRoute: source-record.json.explicitFieldMappings is the one family-owned lever the driver reads. Its refusal path returns reason 'explicit_mapping_conflicts_with_field_name', category 'mapping_conflict' — a conflict detector used as a deny-list. It would refuse the field, and it would record a false reason for the refusal: the mapping does not conflict, the field is protected. The batch-1 review said of exactly this pattern that it is the label-only behaviour the binder's own header says it inverted, and declined to recommend it. Declining it here too.
whyNoSmallestFamilyOwnedCorrectionExists.conclusion: The correction belongs in the shared layer, which this task forbids changing — correctly, since another lane owns it.

smallestCorrectSharedCorrections.change: decode CID-encoded text through the font's encoding before storing effectiveLabel and regionHeading, so the geometry channel receives text rather than code points
smallestCorrectSharedCorrections.closes: ESC-GEOMETRY-NOT-AN-INPUT for this family and for every other form with a subset font using a code offset
smallestCorrectSharedCorrections.mutationThatMustTurnRed: restore the undecoded capture and printedname must go back to binding by field_name

smallestCorrectSharedCorrections.change: refuse a field whose widgets span disjoint region contexts. One value written into two different blocks cannot be correct in both, and the binder currently sees only one region for a multi-widget field.
smallestCorrectSharedCorrections.closes: ESC-CAPTION-VARIANTS for this family; it is the general form of the duplicated-write defect
smallestCorrectSharedCorrections.mutationThatMustTurnRed: collapse the multi-widget check and printedname must go back to writing on both pages
